$comment: Allowlist of vendored source. Only iframe-free, composable component modules are vendored. See vendor/threeui/README.md for the rationale and the rejection list.
$renameComment: Applied by scripts/sync-vendor.mjs to the vendored text files, and re-applied in --check mode so drift is still caught. The MIT licence permits modification and the notice obligation is unaffected. The upstream project name is a product name, not a licence grant: these tokens reach the rendered DOM as CSS class names, or ship in the bundle as a canvas font stack, so the product must not carry them.
$stripComment: Removed from the vendored text files by scripts/sync-vendor.mjs, and removed again in --check mode so drift is still caught. The upstream stylesheet inlines a base64 WOFF2 under the family name 'ThreeUI Fragment Mono'. Stripping the @font-face rule drops roughly 40 KiB of base64 from the page CSS, removes a bundled OFL font and its notice obligation, and removes a vendor product name from a font-family declaration this product would otherwise ship. The rest of the font stack is a system monospace chain, which is what the components already fall back to.
